decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: PROP GF 11,&nbsp; PROP FF 12,&nbsp; PROP&nbsp; ROOF 14,&nbsp; PROP ELEV 15,&nbsp; PROP SITE 10, PROP GF 11,&nbsp; PROP SITE 03,&nbsp; reasonable exception Statement ( Dated 11.06.25) , Heritage statement (dated 05.08.25) and Design and Access statement (dated 05.08.25)&nbsp;
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence above slab level until samples of the materials for&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px;">brickwork and pointing&nbsp;</span>to be used in the construction of the mock Tudor on the front elevation<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">.</span>&nbsp;The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p style="margin-left: 0cm;">Notwithstanding the
     plans hereby approved, the side roof dormer shall be amended to include a
     hipped pitched roof and the details for this shall be provided to and
     approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the
     commencement of the relevant part of the works. Works shall be built and
     retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation, Alterations to roof to form front, side and rear dormers, Roof light in rear roof slope, External alterations
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
